title: When anger rises quickly after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: The mind reacts before truth and proportion have time to speak. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru turns the battle inward so reaction loses its claim to righteousness. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity. Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it.
actionPrompt: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.

source.shortMeaning: Where does ego come from? How can it be removed?
